headline: Vietnam Ministry Says Proposed US Tariff Could Fall Under Trade Agreement
summary: Vietnam's Ministry of Industry and Trade stated that the proposed 35% US tariff could be reduced to 20% if both nations reach a reciprocal trade agreement.
why: Bilateral trade negotiations and potential tariff adjustments directly impact export volumes and manufacturing margins for emerging export-oriented economies.

impacts.name: Vietnam
impacts.why: Trade negotiations determine whether high tariff proposals will be mitigated.
